batch_node.name: aws_core schedules v0.1
batch_node.description: A daily run of the aws_core boto3 collector, so the estate fills without a manual fire. One fire reads the account and regions the worker's collector secret scopes (stage: one account, us-gov-west-1) and writes nodes; it sends nothing.

node.name: AWS Core collection daily
node.description: 03:15 UTC daily, one run at a time. Reads through the collector role (SecurityAudit) assumed from the worker task role; writes only AWS resource nodes.

entity.name: AWS Core collection daily targets boto3
